newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks end down on strike call.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks end down on strike call.

text.p: Shares on the Caracas stock exchange eased for a third consecutive day on Wednesday after the Confederation of Venezuelan Workers (CTV) called for a national strike on August 6.
The 19-share index shed 0.73 percent, or 69.16 points, to close at 9,409.27, with 31 shares lower, 12 higher and three unchanged.
CTV called the strike to protest against a rise in gasoline prices due to take place on Thursday and delays in paying salary increases to private sector workers.

"People are a bit turned off with the strike call and we still can't see any quick solution to the salary problem and the rising cost of services," said Gonzalo Alonso, a trader for Activalores Sociedad de Corretaje.
Volume stood at 7.2 billion bolivars ($14.6 million) through 1,202 trades on 49.3 million shares, according to preliminary exchange data.
